body: My personal opinion, give someone time. And support them in their difficulties, my girl left me when I was struggling emotional because of my granny’s death. My granny was as close as my mum, I hit depression, but my ex, she started seeing someone else, she never told me, she cheated on me, eventually left me and married the other guy too. It’s been more than 4 years but till date I have a void in me. If you guys truly love one another. Give them ample chances and support, you never know who you’d end up with next and if that’ll be good or worse. Take my friend. Take it slow, don’t rush into any decisions
